findings.title: Possibly missing: category_certificate (conditional)
findings.explanation: This document is required when "applicant belongs to a Scheduled Tribe, Scheduled Caste, or OBC category". No document of this type was uploaded — confirm whether the condition applies to you.
findings.sourceRequirementEvidence:
Applicants belonging to a Scheduled Tribe, Scheduled Caste, or OBC category must submit a
    valid Category Certificate issued by a competent authority.

findings.title: Missing required document: residence_certificate
findings.explanation: The requirements state this document is mandatory, but no document of this type was found in the packet.
findings.sourceRequirementEvidence: Residence Certificate confirming domicile in Nagaland.

findings.title: Conflicting full name across documents
findings.explanation: Different documents report different values for full name: "Wonthong Yeptho" (b-form) vs "Wonthong T. Yeptho" (b-id) vs "Wonthong Yeptho" (b-transcript).

findings.title: Conflicting date of birth across documents
findings.explanation: Different documents report different values for date of birth: "2003-07-17" (b-form) vs "2003-07-14" (b-id).

findings.title: gpa or marks does not meet stated rule
findings.explanation: Requirement expects gpa_or_marks gte "6", but the packet shows "5.4" (b-transcript).
findings.sourceRequirementEvidence:
The applicant must have obtained a minimum aggregate of 6.0 CGPA (or 60%) in the most
    recent academic year.

findings.title: Expired document: income certificate
findings.explanation: This document's expiry date (31/01/2026) is before the audit date (2026-03-15).

findings.title: Wrong financial year on income/bank document
findings.explanation: Requirement specifies financial year 2025-26; document "b-income" shows 2024-25.
findings.sourceRequirementEvidence: The Income Certificate must be issued for financial year 2025-26.

findings.title: Unsupported file format: voter-id.heic
findings.explanation: File type "image/heic" is not in the accepted formats (application/pdf, image/jpeg, image/png).
findings.sourceRequirementEvidence: All documents must be submitted as PDF, JPEG, or PNG files no larger than 10 MB each.

findings.title: Missing page(s): transcript
findings.explanation: Requirement expects 2 page(s); b-transcript has 1.
findings.sourceRequirementEvidence:
The Academic Transcript must include both pages; a single-page transcript will not be
    accepted.

findings.title: Missing signature: application form
findings.explanation: No signature was detected on this document (confidence 0.88).
findings.sourceRequirementEvidence: The Application Form must bear the applicant's signature.

findings.title: Bank account holder name does not match applicant name
findings.explanation: The application identifies the applicant as "Wonthong Yeptho", but the bank document lists the account holder as "W. Yeptho". The notice requires the bank document to be in the applicant's own name.
findings.sourceRequirementEvidence: Bank Passbook or Statement showing the applicant's own name as account holder.
